description: Week-one prior medians and log-time slopes per progression category, used by main.py. Medians are set from mature Sony-wide trophy rates of GTA V / Red Dead Redemption 2, scaled by how far players get in seven days. See MODEL.md for the full reasoning and sources.

sources.gta5_tracker: PocketPSN (tracker sample, denominator includes dormant owners; shape only): https://pocketpsn.com/game/3375-grand-theft-auto-v/KairoNoKizzy
sources.gta6_launch_night: Competition kit practice cases p00.in / p01.in: 638 players tracked, every rate 0.63-2.04% except the opening mission at 100%
sources.rdr2_sony: PSN Trophy Leaders, Sony Percent Earned, 522,425 players tracked: https://psntrophyleaders.com/game/view/red-dead-redemption-2-ps4
sources.refresh: Competition rules: launch-night page unchanged for hours, then a refresh to 3,868 players tracked with every rate but the 100% one lower

spread.note: Calibrated on synthetic finals: mean loss 0.160 at base 0.50, 0.175 at 0.65, 0.202 at 0.80; 0.65 chosen as a robustness compromise, not the simulator optimum
